name: application-schema-field-list
title: Schema Field List
description: Database-table schema listing with column name, type badge, nullable/not-null state, and a primary-key marker — distinct from feature-flag-table, which lists boolean flags with rollout percentages rather than column definitions.
useWhen: Documenting a database table's column definitions for reference.
You want the primary key visually distinct from other columns via an icon marker.
Nullable vs not-null state should be scannable at a glance.
avoidWhen: You're listing boolean feature flags with rollout percentages — use feature-flag-table instead.
You need an editable schema builder with add/remove controls — this is a read-only reference list.
You need row-level data, not column definitions — use a data table instead.
responsiveBehavior: The card has a fixed max width; column name and type stay on one row, with not-null/nullable status right-aligned via ml-auto.
accessibility: The primary-key icon carries role='img' with an aria-label of 'Primary key' rather than relying on icon shape alone.
Not-null fields use bolder text weight in addition to the label text, not color alone.
Column names render as monospace <code> to visually distinguish them from type badges.

variants.title: Schema field list
variants.description: A 5-column 'users' table schema with a primary-key marker on id and correct nullable/not-null states, on a light surface.
accessibility: Only one field is marked as the primary key, matching real schema semantics.

variants.description: The same users table schema, adapted for dark surfaces.
